metric_spec.input: decoded uint8 L or RGB pixels; saved display PNG for recovery
metric_spec.ssim_border: valid only; discard 5 pixels on every side
metric_spec.ssim_channels: arithmetic mean of per-channel scores for RGB

storage: Lossless displayed PNGs, source bytes, parameters and float64 hashes retained; no per-frame NPY files. Recompute the core to reproduce float values.
display: one-factor sweeps: lambda varies with kappa=2; kappa varies with lambda=.02 for photos or .008 for JPEG. No interpolation.
